data_description.influxdb_enabled: Write each processed charging receipt to InfluxDB after every run.
data_description.influxdb_host: Hostname of your InfluxDB 1.x server (e.g. a0d7b954-influxdb for the HA add-on).
data_description.influxdb_database: Target database. Points are written to the 'charge_receipt' measurement.
data_description.influxdb_username: Leave blank if your InfluxDB has authentication disabled.

export_to_influxdb.name: Export to InfluxDB
export_to_influxdb.description: Write all charging receipts to InfluxDB (upsert). Requires InfluxDB enabled in Options.

export_to_csv.name: Export to CSV
export_to_csv.description: Export all charging data to a CSV file.

trigger_extraction.name: Trigger manual extraction
trigger_extraction.description: Manually process EV charging emails and EVCC data.
